paper_title: Enumerating Minimal Dominating Sets in Triangle-Free Graphs
classifications: Theory of computation → Design and analysis of algorithms
statement: In this paper, we proved that the set of minimal dominating sets of a triangle-free graph, hence bipartite graph, can be enumerated in output-polynomial time. It remains open whether a polynomial delay algorithm exists for these classes.
context: 5 Conclusion In this paper, we proved that the set of minimal dominating sets of a triangle-free graph, hence bipartite graph, can be enumerated in output-polynomial time. It remains open whether a polynomial delay algorithm exists for these classes. The most general open problem on the topic discussed in this paper is whether the minimal dominating sets of a co-bipartite graph can be enumerated in output-polynomial time. Indeed, as noted in the introduction this would imply that such an algorithm also exists for the general case. Other classes where no output-polynomial time algorithms are known include unit disk graphs and graphs of bounded expansion, according to [20, 11].
